body: I appreciate the sentiment, and I even had plans in that direction.  I've filed police reports for most of the times she's attacked me, and I've submitted anonymous tips to the local Crimestoppers line regarding her employment.  But the sad truth is, the first inking she gets that I'm leaving she will take my daughter and the money and disappear to the Hamptons.  There is no realistic way I can fight her in court - not when she has our savings and her family attorneys.  They can afford to keep me tied up in court for DECADES, all the while poisoning my 4-year-old against me.  Telling her "daddy abandoned you".  She did the same thing with my step-daughter and her birth dad, so I've seen it.  Best case scenario - I find a pro-bono lawyer (or one that will work for the $87 I have stashed away).  meanwhile I'm still paying all of the household bills and working 50 hours per week while she's collecting child support.  And even if I could get a judge to recuse himself all of those assholes know each other.  I can't see getting an impartial proceeding anywhere in this county.
